newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Two Serbian policemen shot in Kosovo.
newsitem.headline: Two Serbian policemen shot in Kosovo.

text.p: Two Serbian policeman were seriously injured in an ambush in the mainly Albanian southern province of Kosovo, Belgrade media reports said on Saturday.
They were attacked on Friday night in Srbica west of the Kosovo capital of Pristina.
The reports said the area was sealed by large forces of police with armoured vehicles and that a number of people were arrested.
Ethnic Albanians, many of whom favour independence, outnumber Serbs nine to one in Kosovo although it is an integral part of Serbia.
